newsitem.title: USA: Robertson Stephens adds 3 senior research analysts.
newsitem.headline: Robertson Stephens adds 3 senior research analysts.

text.p: Investment banking firm Robertson Stephens & Co said on Tuesday it added three senior research analysts: Gary Craft, Jeff Barnes and Jay Silverman.

Gary Craft is a specialist in electronic commerce and payment systems segment of the Information Services industry. He was formerly co-head of technology research for Friedman Billings Ramsey & Co, Robertson Stephens said in a release.

Jeff Barnes will cover medical devices, focusing on cardiovascular devices, urological instruments and medical imaging systems. He was previously at Needham & Co, covering the medical device and health care technology industries.

Jay Silverman will focus on first-generation biotechnology companies, the antiviral market and other emerging biopharmaceutical firms. Before joining Robertson Stephens, he spent five years as a vice president and senior analyst for biotechnology and medical technology at Schroder Wertheim & Co.
